prompts.living: Use case: sketch-to-render. Create an extremely photorealistic MUJI-inspired finished home from the supplied EXACT full-spherical geometry reference. Output a seamless 360x180 degree equirectangular panorama, EXACT 2:1 ratio, 4096x2048 if possible. The image will be mapped inside a sphere: preserve the ENTIRE input projection, camera position, wall edges and furniture locations. Retain spherical distortion and the blank ceiling/floor poles. Left and right edges must match seamlessly. NEVER crop or turn into a flat perspective photo. Materials: natural oak furniture with realistic fine grain, medium warm-brown matte oak-look floor tiles NOT bleached white or orange, off-white matte plaster, unbleached linen and cotton upholstery with seams and wrinkles, restrained ceramics and greenery. Delicate BLACK exterior window frames. Where bedroom/bathroom doors appear they have THIN WHITE perimeter frame, ONE vertical and THREE horizontal white dividers making TWO columns by FOUR rows of OPAQUE milk-glass panes. Soft realistic daylight, ambient bounce, contact shadows, physically believable metal and textiles, architecture photography quality. No cartoon, toy, lowpoly, flat CGI, text, logo, interface, oversaturated timber. Compact Chinese apartment; do not enlarge the room, add windows or invent furniture. Critical latest plan: TV backed by a COMPLETELY SOLID warm-white wall, no internal glazing or black frame or glass privacy curtain ANYWHERE between living and study. Kitchen is OPEN PLAN to dining and entrance: no internal partition, doorway, sliding door, rail or doorframe along these two open sides. Preserve kitchen EXTERIOR walls/windows and short exterior return at its right edge. Preserve existing L-shaped kitchen worktop and freestanding white fridge; no island/bar. Living width3.30m. 65-inch black TV sits centered on1.80m low oak console opposite two-seat beige linen sofa. Behind TV is entirely solid warm-white plaster. Tall leafy rubber tree LEFT of television, not cactus. At far end open dining and open kitchen are visible. Keep original exterior windows and narrow lower window alcove. Simple linen art in same wall frame.
